newsitems.title: An Update on Our Anti-Cheating Measures
newsitems.author: Leftstickdown
newsitems.contents:
[p]We want to give you an update on something frustrating: cheating. Specifically, people using software that plays the game for them. We have been working on this since the beginning and these accounts get detected and banned on an ongoing basis.[/p][h2][b]Why We're Talking About This[/b][/h2][p]We've wanted to talk about this topic for a long time. The reason we haven’t is because any public post about cheating also advertises it. When a studio talks about a cheat, more people go looking for it. So for a long time we’ve been doing the work quietly and tried to let the bans speak for themselves. You, the community, deserve to know what's going on, and you deserve to know what Blue Mammoth Games and Ubisoft are doing about it.[/p][h2]What We're Dealing With[/h2][p]Many games fight cheats like X-ray, auto-aim, teleporting, flying, no-clip, etc. What we’re seeing isn't that kind of cheat. In Brawlhalla, cheaters are running programs that watch the game and press the buttons for them.[/p][p]These programs aren’t capable of doing anything beyond what is within the design of the game. A cheater’s program’s inputs are similar to those of a top level player, which means detecting them accurately takes extra care. They aren't playing the game. They're sitting there watching software play a bot they've named after themselves.[/p][h2]Why This Matters[/h2][p]Brawlhalla has been around for 11 years, and over that time we've all built something special together: the developers, the pros, the content creators, dedicated community members, and every player who has ever queued up.[/p][p]The crazy thing about Brawlhalla is that we spend all our time brawling each other, yet this community has some of the deepest respect and camaraderie we've seen anywhere. That goes for the players and the dev team. It was obvious from the very first BCX.[/p][p]Looking at the level of play right now, like what we saw at the last World Championship and the recent Midseason Championship, it is incredible. Players are better than they've ever been, and the game's combat has never looked better.[/p][p]People who sell and use these bots are trying to undermine all of that. They are not anyone's friend in this community and have even distributed malware capable of silently screenshotting and keylogging on the systems of those who decide to trust them.[/p][h2]Detection[/h2][p]Cheating is changing across the whole industry. Cheat-making is big business and AI is amplifying it. Studios everywhere are dealing with versions of this right now.[/p][p]Our detection keeps getting stronger. We can't go into detail on how, because cheat-makers are reading this too and will use that information to get around it. What we can tell you is that the methods we are developing to catch these bots today are much better than ever before, and we'll keep improving them.[/p][p]Lately, our enforcement has become much stricter. Cheaters are being permanently banned and people who help make or distribute these tools risk future legal action.[/p][p]If you suspect someone is cheating, report them. Despite how it may seem, the in-game reports do actually help. When you report a cheater, there's a good chance we're already watching them and your reports help confirm it. Enforcement isn’t always immediate because we need confidence in the detection and can’t give info that would help cheat makers evade it.[/p][h2]Looking Ahead[/h2][p]No online game can make cheating completely disappear, but what we can do is make it as difficult and expensive as possible so it’s not sustainable. We’ll keep at it and keep you posted.[/p][p]Thanks for reading, and thank you for playing for real.
- Blue Mammoth Games
[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]TL;DR[/b][/h3][p]We’re aware of some players using software to play for them in Ranked. We didn’t publicly address it until now because talking about cheats also advertises them, but the community deserves an update from us. There are always people trying to cheat in online games and we are always working on anti-cheat measures. Our detection is improving and our enforcement is much stricter now. Cheaters are getting permanently banned and cheat-makers risk future legal action. Your in-game reports help confirm ones we’re often already watching, so please use the in-game reporting feature when you can. We are determined to prevent these people from trying to undermine what our community has built.[/p]

After that, you’ll have an extra week to redeem previously earned Tickets or use Mammoth Coins to get the Event Center Items. Put on your swankiest dancing shoes and cut a rug at the 2026 Gala![/i][/p][p][i]Follow the top hats in the store to find everything![/i][/p][list][*][p]NEW Sleepless Metropolis Podium[/p][/*][*][p]NEW 11th Cake-Aversary Emote[/p][/*][*][p]9 returning Skins like Gothic Chic Nix, Gentleman Kor, and Ritzy Bödvar.[/p][/*][*][p]Gala Colors for every Legend[/p][/*][*][p]3 Sidekicks and The Brilliant Bearson Avatar[/p][/*][*][p]9 Emoji Skins[/p][/*][/list][h2]New Store Bundles[/h2][h3]11th Anniversary Mega Bundle[/h3][p][i]Get every previous Anniversary Skin, plus the new Sleepless Metropolis Podium and annual 11th Cake-aversary Emote at a celebratory discount![/i][/p][h2][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5885034/db8658449236d6a36c60fbd05900a95796092f4a.jpg"][/img]High Fashion Bundle[/h2][p][i]Get all the latest from Scarlet’s Fall/Winter ’27 line straight from the runway![/i][/p][h2][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5885034/2d34e4791ef51be0c770b0d275eca197fd5de35c.jpg"][/img]Gentlemen Bundle[/h2][p][i]A dapper collection of some of the finest menswear available in Valhalla.[/i][/p][p][/p][h1][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5885034/0ea59932dd00b9315f72b13a7b390ef25997b41d.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5885034/1862ea59ac84c09f2983d08a3521f382fd436ce2.png"][/img][/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5885034/d3321364dc5a60443e1a08aa1c0f6b927bdf1c57.png"][/img][i]The only Arbiter in this area is the referee! Score touchdowns in the high heavens in the new Elysium Brawlball Map. Featuring jump pads & all-new platform art! [/i][/p][p][i]Elysium Arena will be playable in the New Map dynamic queue Brawl of the Week modes featured throughout the patch, and custom lobbies.[/i][/p][h1][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5885034/46fa93150bc0d2eede38e2594240b042fa3758c0.png"][/img][/h1][p][i]We’re experimenting with some Weapon Spawn improvements and enhancing 4 of Barraza’s Signature attacks. For the full list of changes, visit [/i][url="https://brawlhalla.com/test-features"]brawlhalla.com/test-features[/url][/p][p][/p][h2]Weapon Spawn Improvements[/h2][p][i]In the Experimental Queue, Weapons now spawn based on your positioning while holding a Weapon. There’s also a new Weapon spawn viewer in Training Mode! [/i][/p][h2]Barraza Signature Enhancements[/h2][p][i]Test out the Experimental wall versions for Barraza’s Side Axe, Neutral Blasters, Side Blasters, and Down Blasters Signatures. Available in the Experimental queue. [/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5885034/8a50f5d784642b005358580691f31edb0d187c8b.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5885034/bdcab69d152b7c2e9ceffd7bf6dfbb8d354ae663.png"][/img][/p][p][i]This patch brings Qinghua & Baobao’s first balance pass, making them legal for use in official tournaments. This patch also contains minor adjustments to bring some of the strongest weapons in the game closer in line with the rest of the pack as we enter the balance lock for the Brawlhalla World Championship. We have also included a few improvements to Signatures for underperforming Legends while reining in the speed and power of Signatures for a few of the highest performing Legends.[/i][/p][h2]Katars[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5885034/306b5d843f9d58623cab8217df9aaafa2692d8ca.png"][/img][/p][p][i]We have reduced the Damage of the Katars Side Light and Down Light, and significantly reduced the maximum possible damage of the Katars Down Air, to bring the total rate of Damage to a more reasonable level, especially in strings that use multiple Down Airs and Down Lights. Some of this lost Damage has been shifted into the Neutral Light to better match its general use at or near the end of combos and strings.[/i][/p][list][*][p]Katars Neutral Light: Increased total Damage from 12 to 14.[/p][/*][*][p]Katars Side Light: Decreased maximum total Damage from 8 to 7.[/p][/*][*][p]Katars Down Light: Decreased Damage from 11 to 8.[/p][/*][*][p]Katars Down Air: Decreased maximum total Damage from 14 to 9.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Blasters[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5885034/60ab89ad447b16e1c624311d970823af4a12d332.jpg"][/img][/p][p][i]The Blasters Side Light now has slightly greater Recover time on miss to allow for easier punishment against this ranged attack. The Blasters Down Light now does slightly less Damage to bring this weapon’s overall rate of Damage to a more reasonable level.[/i][/p][list][*][p]Blasters Side Light: Increased total Recover time on miss from 10 Fixed/9 Variable to 12 Fixed/9 Variable.[/p][/*][*][p]Blasters Down Light: Decreased total Damage from 13 to 11.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Chakram[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5885034/abddf397d77fd5726409ccdec680264bf7901f99.png"][/img][/p][p][i]The Chakram Fused Side Air, Split Side Air, and Fused Recovery all allow for less acceleration and maximum speed in the backwards direction on miss to allow for easier pursuit and punishment against reckless use of these attacks.[/i][/p][list][*][p]Chakram Fused Side Air: Decreased the amount of acceleration and maximum speed allowed in the backward direction on miss.[/p][/*][*][p]Chakram Split Side Air: Decreased the amount of acceleration and maximum speed allowed in the backward direction on miss.[/p][/*][*][p]Chakram Fused Recovery: Decreased the amount of acceleration and maximum speed allowed in the backward direction during the later Hit Window, and during the Recover time on miss.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Hammer[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5885034/6776199ed2ecc19fb5dd7b36b1e0c41f9d615b22.png"][/img][/p][p][i]We have increased the Damage of the Hammer Side Light and Down Light to bring this weapon’s rate of Damage up to a more appropriate level for its generally high Time to Hit and overall risk.[/i][/p][list][*][p]Hammer Side Light: Increased Damage from 16 to 17.[/p][/*][*][p]Hammer Down Light: Increased Damage from 7 to 10.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Ada[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5885034/836371f3afad69ceee4c94d071581e5e81ef66bb.png"][/img][/p][p][i]Ada’s Side Spear now has greater Minimum Charge time and Recover time to allow for easier dodges and punishes against this attack. We have also slightly reduced the Damage and Force to bring its power closer in line with similar options on other Legends. Ada’s Down Spear now has greater Minimum Charge time to allow for easier reaction against this attack, and less Damage to bring its reward in line with its overall utility.[/i][/p][list][*][p]Ada Side Spear: Increased Minimum Charge time from 2 to 5; Increased total Recover time from 23 to 27; Decreased Damage from 25 to 23; Decreased Force from 65 Fixed/53 Variable to 65 Fixed/51 Variable.[/p][/*][*][p]Ada Down Spear: Increased Minimum Charge time from 5 to 9; Decreased Damage from 25 to 21.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Caspian[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5885034/38ab9a9d517ec52531e8372b5a98be7d10545fd9.png"][/img][/p][p][i]Caspian’s Side Gauntlets now has less Force to better match the reward with its utility as a side-swapping attack.[/i][/p][list][*][p]Caspian Side Gauntlets: Decreased Force from 70 Fixed/54 Variable to 65 Fixed/52 Variable.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Gnash[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5885034/053fa6026a3f1e9f87cc10fbf41b159a46319181.png"][/img][/p][p][i]We have decreased the Minimum Charge time of Gnash’s Neutral Hammer to bring its overall Time to Hit closer in line with the modern pace of gameplay and other similar Signatures.[/i][/p][list][*][p]Gnash Neutral Hammer: Decreased Minimum Charge time from 11 to 8.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Mako[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5885034/357ce8b13d523c11e21ea09b198ed20375a5cb41.png"][/img][/p][p][i]Mako’s Side Greatsword has an improved setup location and greater threat coverage on hit to allow for more reliable use in most situations. We have also increased the Damage to bring its reward closer in line with its lengthy total duration. Mako’s Down Greatsword now has an improved setup timing and greater Stun to allow for more reliable use in most situations and more leniency in timing a charged combo. We have also increased the Damage to better match this Signature’s overall risk.[/i][/p][list][*][p]Mako Side Greatsword: Improved setup logic during the initial travel; Increased threat coverage near the user during the final slash on hit; Increased maximum total Damage from 24 to 27.[/p][/*][*][p]Mako Down Greatsword: Increased Stun of the first hit from 20 to 27; Delayed setup location timing to allow for slightly more lenient charge time release; Increased Damage from 22 to 25.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Qinghua & Baobao[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5885034/aaf4ea47eb16e34c8d28130e94425d9756bffc82.png"][/img][/p][p][i]Qinghua & Baobao’s Neutral Orb now has less Force to better match its utility and positional reward. The initial Hit Window of their Down Orb now sends horizontally instead of spiking downwards. Their Down Cannon now has less Force to better match its range and overall utility.[/i][/p][list][*][p]Qinghua & Baobao Neutral Orb: Decreased Force from 70 Fixed/54 Variable to 62 Fixed/52 Variable.[/p][/*][*][p]Qinghua & Baobao Down Orb: The angle of Force during the initial Hit Window now sends horizontally.[/p][/*][*][p]Qinghua & Baobao Down Cannon: Decreased Force of the air version from 58 Fixed/48 Variable to 52 Fixed/46 Variable.[/p][/*][*][p]Qinghua & Baobao Side Cannon: Fixed a case where the target could be dropped before the final hit.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Sentinel[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5885034/2d154f71f6ce9c079ed3c6e7d43ee747dec489c3.png"][/img][/p][p][i]Sentinel’s Neutral Katars now has less Recover time and allows for more momentum before the attack to bring this Signature closer in line with the pace of modern gameplay. Sentinel’s Neutral Hammer now has less Minimum Charge time and allows for more momentum to bring this Signature closer in line with the pace of modern gameplay.[/i][/p][list][*][p]Sentinel Neutral Katars: Decreased total Recover time from 20 to 16; Increased the amount of allowed momentum during the Time to Hit.[/p][/*][*][p]Sentinel Neutral Hammer: Decreased Minimum Charge time from 12 to 10; Increased the amount of allowed momentum during the Time to Hit.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Teros[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5885034/b8c891e80065c6c7895d8934d4cf17f2b13fb620.png"][/img][/p][p][i]While we’ve reduced the maximum Charge time of Teros’ Side Axe to fix an animation bug, this change does have a minor effect on how quickly bonus Damage and Force is gained during a Charge, resulting in an almost negligible increase at Minimum Charge.[/i][/p][list][*][p]Teros Side Axe: Decreased maximum Charge time from 84 to 75.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Zariel[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5885034/1fd9c77034626e0a02b9827b9ced63a9dd377572.png"][/img][/p][p][i]Zariel’s Neutral Bow now has less Force and Damage to bring its reward more in line with its risk and utility. We have also increased its Minimum Charge time to allow for easier reaction against and maneuvering around this attack. Similarly, Zariel’s Down Gauntlets now has greater Minimum Charge time to allow for easier reaction against and maneuvering around this attack. We have also decreased the Force to better match its overall utility.[/i][/p][list][*][p]Zariel Neutral Bow: Decreased Force from 50 Fixed/47 Variable to 48 Fixed/44 Variable; Decreased total Damage from 23 to 21; Increased Minimum Charge time from 9 to 12.[/p][/*][*][p]Zariel Down Gauntlets: Increased Minimum Charge time from 11 to 14.; Decreased Force from 58 Fixed/54 Variable to 55 Fixed/51 Variable.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5885034/31da9083b8b475da4454b3ebdcf1b7da0b6d827d.png"][/img][/p][p]To make Brawlhalla’s massive roster more approachable, we’re lowering a large amount of Legend Gold prices in Mallhalla. While recently released Legends, will remain at their current Gold prices, the total amount of Gold to unlock Brawlhalla’s roster as a free-to-play player has decreased by approximately 33%. Also, there will now be a much wider variety of Weapons and Legends available for 900 Gold![/p][p] Choices for price reduction were based on Legend variety in a price tier, Weapon availability per price tier, complexity or difficulty of the Legend, and amount of Legends available in the price tier. No Legend Gold prices were increased.[/p][p] Legends lowered to 900 Gold[/p][list][*][p]Lord Vraxx[/p][/*][*][p]Sentinel[/p][/*][*][p]Sidra[/p][/*][*][p]Petra[/p][/*][*][p]Reno[/p][/*][*][p]Munin[/p][/*][*][p]Thea[/p][/*][*][p]Imugi[/p][/*][/list][p] Legends lowered to 2300 Gold[/p][list][*][p]Thatch[/p][/*][*][p]Azoth[/p][/*][*][p]Kor[/p][/*][*][p]Mirage[/p][/*][*][p]Isaiah[/p][/*][*][p]Lin Fei[/p][/*][*][p]Dusk[/p][/*][*][p]Thor[/p][/*][*][p]Jaeyun[/p][/*][/list][p] Legends lowered to 3900 Gold[/p][list][*][p]Ulgrim[/p][/*][*][p]Val[/p][/*][*][p]Ragnir[/p][/*][*][p]Cross[/p][/*][*][p]Caspian[/p][/*][*][p]Kaya[/p][/*][*][p]Jiro[/p][/*][*][p]Zariel[/p][/*][*][p]Fait[/p][/*][*][p]Vector[/p][/*][*][p]Volkov[/p][/*][*][p]Mako[/p][/*][*][p]Arcadia[/p][/*][*][p]Seven[/p][/*][*][p]King Zuva[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5885034/d8da2593ed233151db988bfe931b9363ef09dd9c.png"][/img][/p][h2]Art & Animation[/h2][list][*][p] Adjusted Lord Vraxx’s Legend select animation to work better with his Omniscient Vraxx skin.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5885034/a42b30bcc11030d597dcfcf9dab1a6b45361b91d.png"][/img][/p][h2]Art & Animation[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed a bug in which The Mandalorian would have the wrong Blaster Skin equipped during the startup of Blasters Neutral Signature.[/p][/*][/list][h2]UX[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where you weren’t able to report leavers who don’t reconnect in the post-match screen. Now they can’t escape your reports![/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where “Grandmaster of Asgard V” can briefly be seen on new accounts.[/p][/*][/list][h2]UI[/h2][list][*][p]Updated the cursors for the Legend roster in the Legend select screen on console to match the positioning on desktop and be easier to understand which Legend you are selecting..[/p][/*][/list][h2]Localization[/h2][list][*][p] Fixed the spelling for the French translation of Scarecrow Nix Legend Skin[/p][/*][/list]

Behold Magyar’s vengeful souls as they gain more and more power.[/p][/*][*][p]Complete missions to progress through 3 levels of the Skin, ultimately earning the final animated Skin.[/p][/*][*][p]Comes with 2 Weapon Skins per level, including animated Weapon Skins for Greatsword and Hammer[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Progression Podium: Stairway to Elysium[/p][list][*][p]3 Podiums in 1![/p][/*][*][p]Complete missions to progress the Podium into the gates of Elysium.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Apostate’s Visage Avatar[/p][/*][*][p]Fortitude Sidekick[/p][/*][*][p]New Stained Glass Color unlocks[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5885034/d7c9fd0d8a63218faf695433806b94bb599e60c6.png"][/img][/p][p][i]Unlocking the Gold Battle Pass also grants access to get these new rewards:[/i][/p][list][*][p]Zariel the Exalted animated Epic Skin[/p][list][*][p]Includes 2 animated Weapon Skins and custom Signature FX swaps[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]3 more Skins: Arbiter Jhala, Omniscient Vraxx, and Holy Justiciar Vera[/p][list][*][p]Each comes with 2 Weapon Skins[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Stained Glass All Legends Color Scheme[/p][list][*][p]Unlock the new Battle Pass Color for all current and future Legends![/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Archangel’s Arrival Trail Effect[/p][/*][*][p]Divine Encounter KO Effect[/p][list][*][p]They see every KO 👁️[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]All Seeing Weapon Skins for Gauntlets, Hammer, Axe, Scythe, Sword, and Spear[/p][/*][*][p]2 Emotes: Check In and Enraptured[/p][list][*][p]Check in with a lil angel or a truly holy sight[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]3 Sidekicks: Temperance, Prudence, and Justice[/p][/*][*][p]Divine Gate Loading Frame[/p][/*][*][p]Archangel Insignia[/p][/*][*][p]9 Battle Pass Chests[/p][/*][*][p]Plus a bunch of Avatars and Emojis that are already watching you[/p][/*][/list][p][i]The Gold Pass also gives Mammoth Coins, Battle Pass XP Boosters to get stuff quicker, and themed Battle Pass Chests to earn even more Items.[/i][/p][p]Exclusive Deluxe Items
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5885034/438ca34a898ad0ae6848dd9a1f10347a6e8d1901.png"][/img]Get the Gold Pass with 25 instant tier skips plus these holy Items:[/p][list][*][p]Archangel Sidekick[/p][/*][*][p]Celestial’s Flight Emote[/p][/*][*][p]“This Is My True Form” Title[/p][/*][/list][h1][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5885034/ec0a72d7e1440a70cdbe258a7a409d33a001655d.png"][/img][/h1][p]This brand new Map is perfect for 1v1s against the sins of your past or your ranked nemesis.[/p][p]From September 16th to September 23rd, join the New Map queue to be automatically matched into a game on Eternity’s End. There will also be some upcoming Brawl of the Weeks featuring this new Map. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5885034/30f6618e3a5b4e8a7e04927670d2ad4be7ef13f7.png"][/img][/p][h1][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5885034/88651f0f44a7bf22df8396650e230ea5f3c815a2.png"][/img][/h1][p][i]ARRRRRrrrr ya ready to join Sidra's Crew? This Brawlhalloween, we’re sailing across the nine realms from beyond the grave! Earn Brawlhalloween tickets from October 7 through 28 to unlock the new Ghost Pirate Sidra Skin, the ghost parrot Ringo, and more goodies from beyond the grave.[/i][/p][h2]Event Center Items[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5885034/d294bffb4c26d521fe22d406f39d9ec4f190d922.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]GRAND PRIZE: Ghost Pirate Sidra[/p][/*][*][p]Ringo Sidekick[/p][/*][*][p]“Ghost Pirate” Title[/p][/*][*][p]4 Emoji Skins[/p][list][*][p]Reanimated Lookin’ Good[/p][/*][*][p]Corpse Bride Cry[/p][/*][*][p]Werewolf Sweat[/p][/*][*][p]Cth’ink[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][i]Event Center tickets will be earnable from October 7 to October 28. After that, you’ll have an extra week to redeem previously earned Tickets or use Mammoth Coins to get the Event Center Items.[/i][/p][h2]Ghoulish Colors[/h2][p][i]Win a matchmade game with a Legend to earn the Ghoulish Colors for that Legend. Win matchmade games with 45 Legends to earn the Color for all current & future Legends! Check out your progress on the right side of the Event Center.[/i][/p][p]
[i]If you didn’t finish the mission from last year’s Brawlhalloween, your progress will pick up where you left off.[/i][/p][h2]New & Returning to Mallhalla[/h2][p][i]No tricks here, only treats! A new Haunted Manor Podium and all of last year’s Event Center goodies will be available for Mammoth Coins in Mallhalla.[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5885034/99973598c20978d2db73967be3087e02679b5f59.png"][/img][/p][p][i]Follow the pumpkins in the store to find everything![/i][/p][list][*][p]NEW Haunted Manor 2026 Podium[/p][/*][*][p]20 returning Skins like Trick or Treater Kaya, Immortal Caspian, Horseman Lucien, and Cthu’shang[/p][/*][*][p]Haunting Colors for every Legend[/p][/*][*][p]3 Sidekicks and 2 Avatars[/p][/*][*][p]10 Emoji Skins[/p][/*][*][p]Skeleton Dance Emote[/p][/*][/list][h2]New Store Bundles[/h2][h3]Brawlhalloween '26 Mega Bundle[/h3][p][i]The biggest and spookiest bundle! Includes 14 Brawlhalloween Legend Skins and the new Haunted Manor '26 Podium![/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5885034/4be0a77824cd77acf9946f8a153e016c2f7fc5e7.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Graveyard Shift Bundle[/h3][p][i]Be wary of monsters and ghouls as they arise in this bundle, which features the original Graveyard Shift Podium![/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5885034/bcade4548464b3bfdb202ffa508ffa07e373f400.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Trick or Treater Bundle[/h3][p][i]Get your costume ready for a night of trick or treating with the goodies in this bundle![/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5885034/866ff56935a75752b36cf164a2a4cefaad34ead8.jpg"][/img][/p][h1][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5885034/26df9205f00d875de6e0fb3b329cc8d8568cdae8.png"][/img][/h1][h2]UI[/h2][list][*][p]Updated in-match HUD so that Player 2's icon now sorts behind Player 1 to avoid covering damage numbers.[/p][/*][*][p]Qinghua & Baobao’s name is now properly sized on the post match screen. Baobao no longer gets cut off, and she’s really happy about it.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Art & Animation[/h2][list][*][p] Performance improvements for Zariel on all of their Skins.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Mallhalla[/h2][p]Valhalla’s newest dynamic duo, Qinghua & Baobao, has had their Gold price reduced from the 7200 launch price down to the usual 5400.[/p][h2]New Ranked Season[/h2][p]The new Ranked Season 42 will begin on September 23rd! With that comes the final new Ranked Season Avatar. This only affects players that have played Ranked for 42 seasons. If you only have a few Seasons under your belt, you will still earn Avatars based on your Rank until you hit 42 seasons. For the few that are reaching that mark, you’ll be met with a special final Avatar featuring a Mjolnir crown. There are 4 to get as usual: Silver & under, Gold, Platinum, and Diamond.[/p][h2]Sponsored Video Rewards[/h2][p]Since 2023, millions of Brawlers earned Gold and packed their Inventories with Items from Sponsored Video Rewards. Now, we’re working on an improved Rewards system. As a part of this process we’ll be removing Sponsored Video Rewards.[/p][p]Before that, we want to give everyone a chance at one final Grand Chest. Starting September 16, everyone that has been offered Sponsored Video Rewards will have their progress shifted close to the Grand Prize.[/p][p]After September 30th, Sponsored Video Rewards will not be available. We’ll let y’all know when we have more info to share about the new system![/p][h1][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5885034/a42b30bcc11030d597dcfcf9dab1a6b45361b91d.png"][/img][/h1][h2]UX [/h2][list][*][p]Fixed a recurring bug where closing Brawlhalla made the application unresponsive. While we don’t recommend ever closing the game, at least now you can do it more smoothly.[/p][/*][*][p]The Google Play Games switch account option was missing. We found it and added it back to where it should be.[/p][/*][/list][h2]UI[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where typing using the Steam on-screen keyboard could also trigger the Guild filters/help screen popup.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Gameplay[/h2][list][*][p]The Temple Climb Map was removed from the 3v3 Crew Battle Queue. The queue also now uses the 1v1 Ranked Map pool.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the audio on the Noble Steed Emote would continue when it was interrupted by an attack.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Art & Animation[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed a bug in Morph where a player could become permanently unarmed after fully charging Qinghua & Baobao's Cannon Side Signature. Now, Qinghua & Baobao will stay unarmed while they are the active Legend, but will regain their Cannon the next time they are cycled in.[/p][/*][/list]

This year’s Event introduces the first ever Podium for the Event, plus a new earnable Loki Skin, and the return of so many things.[/i][/p][h2]Event Center Items[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5885034/04936472ec84b3f6a282b8928d71ebdbc5e6d7e9.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]GRAND PRIZE: Valedictorian Loki Skin[/p][/*][*][p]4 Emoji Skins[/p][list][*][p]Brawldog 1 More[/p][/*][*][p]Professor Laugh[/p][/*][*][p]Rocker Lookin’ Good[/p][/*][*][p]Kindergarten Wow[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Audrey the 3rd Sidekick[/p][/*][*][p]Side Sig PhD Title[/p][/*][/list][p][i]Event Center tickets will be earnable until September 9th. After that, you’ll have an extra week to redeem previously earned Tickets or use Mammoth Coins.[/i][/p][h2]Home Team Reunion Colors[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5885034/68775956e4abb7d2f482b42c68c1069e5607e387.png"][/img][i]Win a matchmade game with a Legend to earn the Home Team Reunion Colors for that Legend. Win matchmade games with 45 Legends to earn the Color for all current & future Legends! Check out your progress on the right side of the Event Center.[/i][/p][h2]New & Returning to Mallhalla[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5885034/d47821d7171df41d9528fa0c3c297bf88e288926.png"][/img][/p][p][i]Follow the apples in the store to find everything![/i][/p][list][*][p]Protagonist’s Desk Podium[/p][list][*][p]The first ever Podium for a Back to School Event![/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]16 returning Skins like First Day Asuri, Rocker Volkov, Brawldog Mordex, and Band Kid Yumiko[/p][/*][*][p]Home Team Colors for every Legend[/p][/*][*][p]2 Sidekicks and 2 Avatars[/p][/*][*][p]7 Emoji Skins[/p][/*][*][p]Home Team Cheer Emote[/p][/*][/list][h2]New Store Bundles[/h2][h3]Back to School '26 Mega Bundle[/h3][p][i]Get 8 Back to School Event Legend Skins PLUS the 1st ever Back to School Podium: Protagonist's Desk, plus even more supplies for day 1 of classes![/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5885034/46e17c1b04653f3957cb8c9acc5b0cadf7b738af.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Team Spirit Bundle[/h3][p][i]Are you participating in school sports this year? Get your enrollment started with this new bundle![/i][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5885034/de43a4fa5c81ddc29a149d3ba7f508ee7153903b.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]School Faculty Bundle[/h3][p][i]You'll be the talk of the Teacher's Lounge with all the stylish items in this bundle![/i]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5885034/3161e9e46be595b1b6c67e924bd635a43bd083cd.jpg"][/img]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5885034/06cea0277a50d5617220d788eb075e5f96c1d139.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5885034/6899fa7c811d4fc8406ba2c0c4392d4d55d36abc.png"][/img][i]CMYK Colors will also arrive on August 19! [/i][/p][p][i]Similar to RGB, they may be purchased for one Legend at a time or the All Legends Colors which covers all current and future Legends. [/i][/p][p][i][b]Unlike RGB[/b], there’s a new and improved transparent system for getting a Random CMYK Color.[/i][/p][list][*][p]The Legend you are getting the Color for is visible before you buy the random roll as long as you’re online. [/p][/*][*][p]The Legend refreshes every day you log in.[/p][/*][*][p]When you buy a Random CMYK: Legend Color, the Legend updates instantly, [/p][list][*][p]For example: I log in to see my Random CMYK roll is for Imugi. If I wait until tomorrow, it will change randomly to a new Legend. Since I want the CMYK Color for Imugi, I buy it. After I get my Imugi Color, the random CMYK Legend Color randomizes to Thor. I don’t want the color for Thor, so I wait until tomorrow. I log in the next day and see the Random CMYK roll is now for Fait.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][i]The All Legends CMYK Color Scheme works the same as every other All Legends Color Scheme.[/i][/p][h1]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5885034/f0796dc9f35330d135f7a1a829b4f70b2d19ab52.png"][/img][/h1][h2]Crystalforged Weapon Sets[/h2][p][i]Beyond Glory there is immortality! Claim the Crystalforged Weapon Skins so you can match with your Crystalforged Colors. Only unlockable once the Skyforged & Goldforged Weapon Skins have been unlocked. Exclusively purchasable with Glory.[/i][/p][h2][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5885034/9306cc3f5e6aee9ff9aab5e52fbfe973169663a8.png"][/img]Guild Weapon Set[/h2][p][i]Do you fight for your friends? Show it! Become the Level 100 paladin of your dreams with these glowing new Weapon Skins. Exclusively purchasable with Guild Tokens.[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5885034/581bb54d3e91b3594f56fca2c3f4bfb982830cb8.png"][/img][/p][h1][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5885034/ad0a7cc41889506e540ca193d95b44e71d2e983c.png"][/img][/h1][h2]UI[/h2][list][*][p]Reordered the casual queue menu so that Unranked 1v1 displays first and FFA displays last.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Gameplay[/h2][list][*][p]Updated the spawns on the Dodgebomb Map so that Weapons and Gadgets don't fall through the map when spawning in Training Mode.[/p][/*][/list][h1][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5885034/e5a47bf02b5526dc966e69c227936eb00ca03f8f.png"][/img][/h1][h2]Art & Animation[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed a visual bug causing Xull’s base Signature FX to not play correctly when using certain crossover Weapon Skins.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a visual bug where thrown weapons would adopt the custom hit FX of the next weapon you picked up[/p][/*][/list][h2]UX[/h2][list][*][p]Rayman now grants progression for missions that require a Legend that has seen a dragon. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the Brawlball score wasn’t being properly displayed on the scoreboard on the World’s End Arena Map.[/p][/*][/list][h2]UI[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed Twitch Drops pop up text cutoff[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted notifications that were getting cut off when you have a Guild invite while an Event is active.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Gameplay [/h2][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where grapple attacks do not affect the Player4 bot properly in offline tournament mode.[/p][/*][/list][h1][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5885034/af35adbdc85fd1c961021fff48644f7f583268d4.png"][/img][/h1][p][i]For this round of balance adjustments we are increasing the power level of underperforming weapons and Legends through some of their most unique attacks and win conditions. This patch also contains Aurus' first balance pass, making him legal for use in official tournaments.[/i][/p][h2][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5885034/000da40c08e573cd7017acb068d7835560b22e40.jpg"][/img]
Axe[/h2][p][i]The ranged approach and combo starter Side Light now has greater Damage for an overall higher rate of damage, while the Side Air has greater Force to capitalize with earlier knockouts. The Ground Pound also has greater Damage for more reward on this heavy strike.[/i][/p][list][*][p]Axe Side Light: Increased Damage from 10 to 13.[/p][/*][*][p]Axe Side Air: Increased Force from 68 Fixed/41 Variable to 71 Fixed/42 Variable.[/p][/*][*][p]Axe Ground Pound: Increased Damage from a range of 20~18 to a range of 22~20.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5885034/6aac4afde95240da12138ab34228f3241dd3a491.png"][/img][/p][h2]Bow[/h2][p][i]We have increased the Bow Down Air's Force for better positional reward and earlier knockouts when catching opponents with a properly used snipe.[/i][/p][list][*][p]Bow Down Air: Increased Force of the aerial version from 50 Fixed/42 Variable to 50 Fixed/44 Variable.[/p][/*][/list][h2][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5885034/cda0a3c966caabfe3186ada79062cf9423175e86.jpg"][/img]
Greatsword[/h2][p][i]While the Greatsword Down Light Opener is a grounded approach tool that can be used from range to punish outspaced attacks or catch landings, it does use up a lot of the runway extensive Greatsword strings desire. We have increased the Stun of this attack to allow it to true combo into any of its followup chain attacks, but slightly reduced the Damage to keep the reward to reasonable levels. The Down Light Finisher from Side Light Bridge has also received a significant reduction in Time to Hit to better catch certain escape attempts.[/i][/p][list][*][p]Greatsword Down Light Opener: Increased Stun from a range of 15~12 to a range of 22~16; Decreased Damage from 9 to 8.[/p][/*][*][p]Greatsword Down Light Finisher (from Down Light Opener): Decreased Damage from 14 to 13.[/p][/*][*][p]Greatsword Down Light Finisher (from Side Light Bridge): Decreased Time to Hit from 22 to 17.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5885034/838034e6927350d2b54ad90004f3c51c76c5a215.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]Orb[/h2][p][i]We have increased the Stun during the later Hit Window of Orb Down Light to grant more leniency and broader options for combos and followup attacks when using this attack against a grounded opponent. [/i][/p][list][*][p]Orb Down Light: Increased Stun from a range of 21~14 to a range of 21~16.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5885034/6519cec4fd230360f9aa3adfbe9ff047e5c34736.png"][/img][/p][h2]Rocket Lance[/h2][p][i]The Rocket Lance Side Air has regained some of its previous Force for better knockouts when chasing opponents offstage.[/i][/p][list][*][p]Rocket Lance Side Air: Increased Force from 50 Fixed/40 Variable to 55 Fixed/41 Variable.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5885034/33706ee2dc387e111bd459ddf1555a513bc28c52.png"][/img][/p][h2]Scythe[/h2][p][i]The Scythe Down Light is a great way to outspace attacks or catch landings and begin strings, but the risk and larger dodge windows often make this a less desirable option. We have decreased the Recover time on miss and increased the Stun for all versions to allow for easier use and more reliable followups. Similarly, the backwards Active Input of Scythe Neutral Air has greater Stun for tighter dodge windows.[/i][/p][list][*][p]Scythe Down Light: Decreased total Recover time on miss from 10 Fixed/16 Variable to 7 Fixed/16 Variable; Increased Stun of the normal version from 28 to 29; Increased Stun of the Active Input forward version from 18 to 22.[/p][/*][*][p]Scythe Neutral Air: Increased Stun of the Active Input backward version from 18 to 21.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5885034/dffbc5dcf3fcb6fbcd4fce3cec50a377971513e0.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]Spear[/h2][p][i]The Spear Neutral Light now has less Recover time on miss and greater Stun for better use at controlling the ground and converting that control into continued pressure.[/i][/p][list][*][p]Spear Neutral Light: Decreased total Recover time on miss from 6 Fixed/16 Variable to 3 Fixed/16 Variable; Increased Stun of the final hit from 17 to 20.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5885034/817d0f0526e197518aad2828ba0558977d2d43b5.png"][/img][/p][h2]Aurus[/h2][p][i]Aurus's Side Spear now has greater Force to bring its knockout potential closer in line with other similar options. Aurus's Down Spear did not carry proper risk but also grants very little reward on stage, so we have increased both the Recover time on miss and the Damage to even out the risk-reward ratio. Aurus’s Side Chakram now has greater Force to better match its low reach and to be closer in line with other similar options.[/i][/p][list][*][p]Aurus Side Spear: Increased Force from 50 Fixed/50 Variable to 54 Fixed/52 Variable.[/p][/*][*][p]Aurus Down Spear: Increased total Damage from 24 to 28; Increased total Recover time on miss from 15 to 18.[/p][/*][*][p]Aurus Side Chakram: Increased Force from 52 Fixed/52 Variable to 56 Fixed/54 Variable.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5885034/75e58c23864e850d1c3d56a7099bfc3a56d4b9d7.png"][/img][/p][h2]King Zuva[/h2][p][i]King Zuva's Neutral Hammer and Down Hammer now attack faster for more reliable use in the neutral game and when pressuring the opponent.[/i][/p][list][*][p]King Zuva Neutral Hammer: Decreased Minimum Charge time from 11 to 9.[/p][/*][*][p]King Zuva Down Hammer: Decreased Minimum Charge time from 14 to 11; Decreased Time to Hit after release from 9 to 7.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5885034/6fb5d4448a0db9348a63f5059985e06ae5eb997a.png"][/img][/p][h2]Lady Vera[/h2][p][i]Lady Vera's Down Scythe and Neutral Chakram now have less Minimum Charge time for more reliable use as follow-up attacks and dodge punishes, while Lady Vera's Side Chakram now has greater Damage and Force to better fit its role as a powerful knockout tool.[/i][/p][list][*][p]Lady Vera Down Scythe: Decreased Minimum Charge time from 10 to 6.[/p][/*][*][p]Lady Vera Neutral Chakram: Decreased Minimum Charge time from 10 to 7.[/p][/*][*][p]Lady Vera Side Chakram: Increased Damage from 24 to 27; Increased Force from 65 Fixed/52 Variable to 65 Fixed/54 Variable, and the wall version and normal version now have identical Force.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5885034/6cc5d0076a72a9ab5fa7ce48c58b9b71e0d13cbf.png"][/img][/p][h2]Nix[/h2][p][i]We have decreased the Minimum Charge time of Nix's Down Scythe to allow for more threatening use of this long-range attack.[/i][/p][list][*][p]Nix Down Scythe: Decreased Minimum Charge time from 17 to 14.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5885034/0c7d0469ae3ee54027a41ffb563d993dacd48ae1.png"][/img][/p][h2]Ransom[/h2][p][i]Ransom's Neutral Bow now has less Minimum Charge time for better use as an anti-air, while Ransom's Down Bow has greater Force for better use as a knockout tool. We have decreased the Recover time for Ransom's Down Chakram as it was too easily punished in most situations.[/i][/p][list][*][p]Ransom Neutral Bow: Decreased Minimum Charge time from 10 to 8.[/p][/*][*][p]Ransom Down Bow: Increased Force from 50 Fixed/50 Variable to 55 Fixed/52 Variable.[/p][/*][*][p]Ransom Down Chakram: Decreased total Recover time from 24 to 21.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5885034/8987d780efd2d1305536b736475e5d9b47f97dce.png"][/img][/p][h2]Thor[/h2][p][i]Thor's Side Orb now has less Minimum Charge time to better match its short range, while Thor's Side Hammer now has greater Force to better match its lengthy duration and low reach.[/i][/p][list][*][p]Thor Side Orb: Decreased Minimum Charge time from 14 to 12.[/p][/*][*][p]Thor Side Hammer: Increased Force from 65 Fixed/46 Variable to 65 Fixed/50 Variable.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5885034/e3630e3ec6381e6330a75a8845821249d65b548a.png"][/img][/p][h2]Volkov[/h2][p][i]Volkov's Neutral Axe now has less Minimum Charge time for quicker response as an anti-air, a greater range of possible attack heights, and allowing it to combo from a close-hit Side Light. Volkov's Side Scythe now has greater Force to bring this attack closer in line with similar knockout options.[/i][/p][list][*][p]Volkov Neutral Axe: Decreased Minimum Charge time from 10 to 7.[/p][/*][*][p]Volkov Side Scythe: Increased Force from 58 Fixed/50 Variable to 60 Fixed/53 Variable; Increased Force of the Active Input forward version from 50 Fixed/50 Variable to 55 Fixed/53 Variable.[/p][/*][/list]

newsitems.title: Brawlhalla x Shrek Crossover Event - Patch 10.09
newsitems.author: ChickenParmageddon
newsitems.contents: [h1][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5885034/556a2a3cc410fa9d6b5ba53136eee6bad7ae7e2a.jpg"][/img][/h1][p][i]Shrek, Fiona, and Puss in Boots are joining the brawl, and Donkey is coming along as a Companion! They’re also bringing a bunch of fairy tale creatures along as Emojis and a KO Effect, plus they’ll have home field advantage on two new Shrek’s Swamp Maps.[/i][/p][p][i]Also, there are new Guild Emoji Skins to grab, a major update to the Account Linking UI, and a slew of bug fixes including a fix to the Sandbagger achievement. That should be properly earnable now![/i][/p][h1][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5885034/71b8874b0ee5537674f050ec86ad001580b7ad64.png"][/img][/h1][h2]New Themed Items[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5885034/1cc73bd0733d4e3aa984cc2bb4090ace82c962c1.png"][/img][i]Whether swamp dwellers, princesses, or legendary warriors, these three fairy tale creatures have traveled from Far Far Away and are ready to brawl in the Grand Tournament! Plus we’re celebrating even more of Shrek’s colorful characters with the Donkey Companion, Mongo the gingerbread giant KO Effect, and Emojis featuring Lord Farquaad, Dragon, Pinocchio, and the Three Blind Mice.[/i][/p][list][*][p]Shrek[/p][list][*][p]What are you doing in my swamp?![/p][/*][*][p]Crossover for Xull[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Fiona[/p][list][*][p]Maybe you shouldn’t judge people before you get to know them.[/p][/*][*][p]Crossover for Tezca[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Puss in Boots[/p][list][*][p]Fear me if you dare.[/p][/*][*][p]Crossover for Asuri[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Donkey Companion[/p][list][*][p]In the morning’ I’m makin’ waffles![/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Mongo KO Effect[/p][list][*][p]Not the gumdrop button![/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]8 New Emojis[/p][list][*][p]Outhouse BRB, Dragon Heart, Three Blind Mice Lookin’ Good, Lord Farquaad Thumbs Down, Pinocchio GG, Fiona Wait, Shrek Facepalm, and Puss in Boots 1 More[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h2]New Maps & Brawl of the Week Modes[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5885034/a7c84fff8f9740e5aa99ae62b19cb577484ecbf4.png"][/img][i]Inspired by Shrek’s dwelling, we’ve added the new Competitive Map: Shrek’s Swamp and a new FFA Hazard Map: Shrek’s Muddy Swamp. The muddy swamp is also the setting for two new Brawl of the Week modes.[/i][/p][h3]Swamp Mud Brawl[/h3][p][i]What are you doing in Shrek's swamp? Brawling! Navigate the muddy terrain and come out on top. Score points with every hit & knockout in this 3 minute, 4-player free for all queue[/i][/p][h3]Muddy Gadget Mayhem[/h3][p][i]This is the part where you run away - it's absolute mayhem! Score the most points by throwing Gadgets at your opponents in this 3 minute, 4-player free for all. Navigate through the muddy terrain while dodging Gadgets to come out on top![/i][/p][h2]New Free Title Rewards[/h2][p][i]Get a different Title inspired by the 3 new crossover characters by logging in each week [/i][/p][list][*][p]1st week of July 29: "Get Ogre Yourself"[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]2nd week of 08/05: "Not Your Average Damsel"[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]3rd week of 08/12: "El Gato Con Botas"[/p][/*][/list][p][i]DreamWorks Shrek © 2026 DreamWorks Animation LLC. All Rights Reserved. [/i][/p][h1][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5885034/cadd6ca9e0fc9992077a0a05802fd28ae19837e0.png"][/img][/h1][p][i]The set of Emoji Skins exclusive for Guilds are now complete! You can now have a Guild Emoji Skin equipped for every type. Exclusively purchasable with Guild Tokens.[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5885034/a9fc067b394fd8bcd866db568deb00bab9cea463.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5885034/76d0841d7867ce4de71d0b58eff672952b656f08.png"][/img][/p][h2]UI[/h2][list][*][p]In Steam big picture mode, it's now possible to use virtual keyboards when user input is required.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated UI on the Incorrect Version error popup.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated UI on the Account Linking screen.[/p][/*][/list][h2][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5885034/9e8c00c260abcbc6f78738322e4598973fd3df62.png"][/img]UX[/h2][list][*][p]Companions are now included in the Image Render Tool![/p][/*][*][p]On PC & Mac, you can now back out of the Image Render Tool with a controller.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Gameplay[/h2][list][*][p]Brawlball: improved bot logic so bots are now better at throwing Weapons to pick up the Brawlball.[/p][/*][/list][h1][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5885034/b199fdc50bb0eca946de7410d79e1fb58ebe50fd.png"][/img][/h1][h2]Gameplay[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where the Sandbagger achievement could not be earned.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where Aurus' Down Chakram would not properly detect hard platforms while overlapping with a soft platform.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug with bot pathing in Brawlball.[/p][/*][*][p]Console: fixed a bug where training mode numbers did not display properly.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Art & Animation[/h2][list][*][p]Adjusted Vivi's Legend select animation layering to work better with Blaster skins that are supposed to cover the forearm like Mega Man's Mega Buster.[/p][/*][*][p]Added previously missing capes on Mecha Knight Magyar and Ashen Warmonger Roland in
